temporal_invariants.posterior_chain: single contiguous chain with no year-boundary reset

models.M0: Direct v0.6.4 feature delegation; no feature, parameter or control substitution.
models.M1: M0 plus k=1 and k=2 annual Fourier innovation component; ridge prior precision 4.0.
models.M2: M1 plus partially pooled calendar-month residual global->flow->CN4->partner->cell, weighted-zero-sum centered after every update.

recovery.checkpoint: immutable freeze, adjudication, posterior and Z_post per target
recovery.resume: verify the previous posterior hash against its Z_post before freezing the next target; never reopen or overwrite a sealed target
recovery.manifest: SHA-256 manifest verifies every derived artifact; raw archive remains RAM-only

verification.m0_exact_equivalence: test_m0_feature_delegation_is_exact compares v0.6.5 delegation with v0.6.4 byte-identical numpy feature values.
verification.zero_sum: test_m2_residual_is_centered_and_future_free checks centered residual mass and no pre-update seasonal signal.
verification.weights: test_weights_are_separate_and_post_outcome proves no cross-target update and only explicit post-outcome score mutation.
